facts.fact: Analyst Darwin Costa, interviewed by Portal de T.I., says Angola's active internet exchange points, Angonix and Angola-IXP, are both in Luanda.

facts.fact: Analyst Darwin Costa says most of Angola's international submarine cables, SAT-3/WACS, WACS and SACS, land in the Luanda region at Cacuaco or Sangano, with 2Africa still to come.
